titulo: Sus hijos querían desconectarlo para quedarse con la herencia… pero él nunca estuvo en coma 😱
legenda: Tres meses fingiendo estar en coma para descubrir la verdad sobre sus propios hijos… ¿Qué crees que descubrió? Comenta PARTE 2 👇
estilo: Vertical 9:16 video, photorealistic Mexican telenovela look, cinematic, dramatic night lighting, shallow depth of field

personagens.DON: Don Aurelio, 75-year-old wealthy Mexican man, pale skin, gray hair combed back, short gray stubble, wearing a light blue hospital gown, nasal oxygen cannula and an IV line in his arm, lying in a hospital bed
personagens.VALERIA: Valeria, 40-year-old Mexican woman, sleek straight black hair, heavy makeup, red lipstick, wearing an elegant black designer dress, gold jewelry and holding a luxury handbag, cold and greedy expression
personagens.JULIAN: Julián, 45-year-old Mexican man, slicked-back dark hair, thin mustache, wearing a gray suit with an open white shirt and a gold watch, arrogant expression
personagens.ENFERMERA: Lucía, 28-year-old Mexican nurse, kind face, dark hair in a neat bun, wearing light blue scrubs with a stethoscope around her neck

cenarios.HOSPITAL: private luxury hospital room at night, beeping heart monitor beside the bed, bouquet of white flowers, large window with blurred city lights, soft cold blue light mixed with warm lamp light

clips.camera: opens on a close-up of Don Aurelio motionless with eyes closed, then pulls back to a medium shot of Valeria and Julián standing beside the bed; the nurse adjusts the IV in the background, silent
clips.acao: Valeria looks at her unconscious father with contempt and points at the heart monitor; Julián nods coldly and checks his gold watch; Don Aurelio stays completely still with eyes closed
falas: Ya pasaron tres meses, Julián. Papá no va a despertar. Desconectemos esa máquina y repartamos la herencia.
Tienes razón, hermana. Mañana firmamos y todo es nuestro.

clips.camera: medium shot of the nurse alone by the bed; Don Aurelio suddenly opens his eyes and grabs her wrist; quick push-in to a close-up of his face; at the end he turns his head and looks directly into the camera
clips.acao: The siblings have left. Don Aurelio suddenly opens his eyes and firmly grabs the nurse's wrist; the nurse gasps in shock; for the last line he turns his face slowly toward the camera, breaking the fourth wall, with a serious and mysterious look
falas: No grites, hija. Nunca estuve en coma. Graba todo lo que digan mañana.
looking directly into the camera, mysterious
Si quieres saber qué va a pasar, comenta parte dos.
